subject: IRP customization request + SIG Q&A and temporary SFTP access window
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@terrahealth.com>
To: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: rajiv.menon@procurecloud.com
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: tailored IRP + SIG follow-ups and temporary SFTP for artifacts

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the briefing yesterday. TerraHealth is running a SIG review next week and our security/compliance team has two asks we need to complete before the panel: a short Q&A on your Incident Response Plan (tailored for our deployment pattern) and a temporary mechanism to ingest artifacts (logs, sanitized telemetry samples) for our audit team.

Specifically:
- Can you provide a short (1–2 page) mapping of Redwood's IRP to typical healthcare incident flows (PHI exposure, compromised service account, data exfil attempt)? We need this by EOD Monday (4/5) if possible.
- We will need a secure upload window where we can deposit samples (redacted) and a small set of support logs. SFTP with a time-limited folder is preferred — recommended retention 7 days. If SFTP is not feasible, secure HTTPS upload or a pre-signed S3 link is fine.
- Third, a live Q&A slot (30 min) with whoever owns IR and forensic exports — can you propose availability?

I can share the SIG questionnaire (we've flagged 7 control items for follow-up) — attached is a list of the key questions we expect. We also require a brief attestation that any artifacts we upload will be handled only for audit purposes and retained no longer than the agreed window.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Torres
Director, Security & Compliance
TerraHealth

Attachment: terra_sig_flagged_items.pdf (PDF)

From: mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@terrahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: tailored IRP + SIG follow-ups and temporary SFTP for artifacts

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and for the flagged SIG items. We can support this end-to-end. Outline below with owners and immediate next steps.

What we can deliver by Monday (4/5):
- Two-page IRP mapping focused on PHI/data exfil and credential compromise scenarios (owner: Mina Haddad).
- A prepared set of sanitized log samples and an evidence index that shows what we intend to share (owner: Marissa Cole).
- A 30-minute Q&A with our IR lead; available windows listed below.

SFTP proposal / temporary access:
- We can stand up a time-limited SFTP folder at sftp://files.redwood-inference.com/terrahealth/temp/2027-04-03/ with ACLs scoped to TerraHealth upload IPs. Access will expire automatically after 7 days. (owner: Karthik)
- We will provide an evidence manifest template and expect uploads to include a short README that notes redaction status.

Proposed Q&A times (PDT): Mon 4/5 11:00–11:30, Mon 4/5 15:00–15:30, Tue 4/6 09:00–09:30. Please confirm preferred slot.

I am looping in Marissa and Karthik to prepare the sample set and the SFTP window. We'll also prepare a short attestation for handling/uploaded artifacts (we will not retain uploaded files beyond the agreed window and will provide a post-upload deletion confirmation).

Action items for Monday EOD:
- Deliverable: redwood_irp_v2.pdf (2-page mapping) — Mina
- Deliverable: sig_questionnaire_responses.xlsx (prelim answers to flagged items) — Marissa
- SFTP temp folder live with creds and README — Karthik (by Monday 14:00 PDT)

Thanks — we'll treat this as high priority.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_irp_outline.docx (DOCX)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@terrahealth.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: tailored IRP + SIG follow-ups and temporary SFTP for artifacts

Elena — SFTP folder is now provisioned. Details below and next steps.

SFTP details (temporary)
- Host: files.redwood-inference.com
- Path: /terrahealth/temp/2027-04-03/
- Username: terra_elena_upload
- Auth: key-based only (we will send a one-time encrypted key payload)
- Window: 2027-04-05 14:00 PDT -> 2027-04-12 14:00 PDT (7 days)
- ACL: restricted to TerraHealth upload IPs; transfers logged and we will provide a sample of logs in the evidence bundle.

Attachments uploaded so far: redwood_irp_v2.pdf (attached), sig_questionnaire_responses.xlsx (attached). I also uploaded an initial sample of audit logs: audit-logs-sample.tar.gz (sanitized).

A couple of clarifying questions for TerraHealth before we finalize the attestation text:
1) Do you need a signed NDA addendum for this temporary evidence transfer, or is the existing contract (Section 7, Data Handling) sufficient?
2) For redaction, will TerraHealth provide the redaction manifest (fields removed) or do you want us to perform additional redaction before any internal review?

We will follow up with the encrypted SFTP key via the secure channel and a short deletion confirmation once the folder is torn down.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Security Liaison
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_irp_v2.pdf; sig_questionnaire_responses.xlsx; audit-logs-sample.tar.gz

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@terrahealth.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: rajiv.menon@procurecloud.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: tailored IRP + SIG follow-ups and temporary SFTP for artifacts

Marissa — thanks, we confirmed the 4/5 15:00 PDT slot for the Q&A (I'll join from East Coast; will be on VPN). I appreciate the quick turnaround and the evidence uploads.

To your clarifying questions:
1) NDA addendum — procurement prefers a one-page addendum for audit artifact transfer. Rajiv from procurement is copied; Rajiv, can you share the procurement-approved wording?
2) Redaction manifest — TerraHealth will provide a manifest for anything PHI-related. We will upload our manifest into the SFTP folder and clearly label files that contain PHI (even if redacted).

One last ask: can you include a short note in the IRP mapping about how Redwood handles notification thresholds for regulatory obligations (e.g., when legal/compliance is looped in vs. when customer notification is triggered)? That helps our SIG reviewers.

Thanks again — we will review the attachments and reach out if anything else is needed prior to the 4/5 Q&A.

Best,
Elena
